import re,pathlib
for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.c'):
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 macros=dict((m.group(1), int(m.group(2))) for m in re.finditer(r'#define\s+(\w+)\s+(\d+)', s))
 for m in re.finditer(r'(?:static\s+)?(?:const\s+)?struct\s+sc_asn1_entry\s+(c_asn1_\w+)\s*\[([^\]]*)\]\s*=\s*\{', s):
  name,sizeexpr=m.group(1),m.group(2).strip(); start=m.end(); depth=1; i=start
  while i < len(s) and depth:
   if s[i]=='{': depth+=1
   elif s[i]=='}': depth-=1
   i+=1
  body=s[start:i-1]
  cnt=len(re.findall(r'^\s*\{', body, re.M))
  n=None
  if sizeexpr.isdigit(): n=int(sizeexpr)
  elif sizeexpr in macros: n=macros[sizeexpr]
  if n is not None and cnt>n:
   line=s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1
   print('MISMATCH',p,line,name,'decl',sizeexpr,'=',n,'entries',cnt)
